Bug_Title: NP: Method call passes null for non-null parameter (NP_NULL_PARAM_DEREF_ALL_TARGETS_DANGEROUS)
Bug_Details:
A possibly-null value is passed at a call site where all known
  target methods require the parameter to be non-null.
Either the parameter is annotated as a parameter that should
always be non-null, or analysis has shown that it will always be
dereferenced.
Bug_Explanation: The bug occurs when the processValue method is called with a null value, violating its non-null parameter requirement.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered in the testShowBug method by calling the showBug method of the NonNullParameterBug class. This calls the processValue method with a null parameter, which is not allowed according to the method's definition.
